company.name: DGI Apparel
company.shortDescription: DGI Apparel is a B2B marketplace where custom screenprinters can get all the resources they need to run their business.
company.description: DGI allows users to connect their existing vendor accounts and compare prices, inventory, and shipping times for all of their merchants on a single website. They can also manage their vendor carts, check out, and receive purchase tracking and statistics directly from DGI.

productsAndServices.description: A tool that consolidates all vendor accounts into one platform, allowing users to see personalized pricing, promotions, and real-time inventory from multiple vendors.
productsAndServices.name: Purchasing Platform

productsAndServices.description: Allows users to add their web accounts with major apparel vendors, supporting special and group pricing.
productsAndServices.name: Vendor Integration

productsAndServices.description: Enables users to search all vendor catalogs simultaneously to find the best apparel items and compare prices and availability.
productsAndServices.name: Price Comparison

productsAndServices.description: Allows users to manage all their carts on one page and checkout through their vendor's existing shipping and billing channels.
productsAndServices.name: Cart Management
